subject: reasoning
question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth letter-cluster in the same way as the second letter-cluster is related to the first letter-cluster and the fourth letter-cluster is related to the third letter-cluster.

MGX : VPG :: TZC : CIL :: HPX :?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic : (9) is added to the position value according to English alphabetic series.

So,

 
• MGX : VPG

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7df0d5e3d98b1d6e2a85d19f68c8fa7a277dfc27b04aaea26775ba7f259245c8.png] 

And,

 
• TZC : CIL

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/000d4d4f355fd4875ddbf94887fd6e6e66972b40cba43fc6e46552d8569e28c5.png] 

​Similarly,

 
• HPX :?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e66e95e9d01e454528562460f1a9ffe0601f4a8188bb3a8e01bfde97481ddea8.png] 

​Hence, "OYG" is the correct answer.
